commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== LOCAL WORKSPACE ==='
git status --short --branch
echo
echo '=== LOCAL BRANCHES ==='
git branch -vv
echo
echo '=== WORKTREES ==='
git worktree list --porcelain
echo
echo '=== REMOTE HEADS ==='
git ls-remote --heads origin
echo
echo '=== MAIN VS DEVELOP ==='
if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/develop; then DEV=develop; elif git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/develop; then DEV=origin/develop; else DEV=''; fi
if [ -n "$DEV" ]; then
  printf 'rev-list main...develop: ' && git rev-list --left-right --count main..."$DEV"
  printf 'merge-base: ' && git merge-base main "$DEV"
  echo '--- git cherry main develop ---'
  git cherry main "$DEV" || true
  echo '--- unique commits on develop (no merges) ---'
  git log --oneline --decorate --no-merges main.."$DEV" || true
fi
echo
echo '=== PI CHECKOUT ==='
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && echo ---status--- && git status --short --branch && echo ---branches--- && git branch -vv && echo ---worktrees--- && git worktree list --porcelain && echo ---head--- && git log -1 --oneline --decorate'
